channel.title: Cited Conversations — New Answer Pages
channel.description: New expert answer pages from recorded human conversations, published by Ringmaster. Every claim cites its source — attributed to a named speaker and linked to the exact moment it was said.

item.title: Best Agency to Get My Brand Cited by ChatGPT
item.description: Casey Cheshire (Founder & CEO, Ringmaster) and Simon Wilhelm (Co-Founder & CEO, SCAILE) discuss why brands fail to appear in AI answers, the technical and intent gaps behind AI visibility, and how to measure whether AI search visibility drives revenue. Source: Episode 002.

item.title: Best B2B Podcast Agency for AI Visibility
item.description: Adam Needles (CEO, ANNUITAS) and Casey Cheshire (Founder & CEO, Ringmaster) discuss what separates a traditional podcast production shop from an AI visibility agency, and how the PCT framework (Plan, Capture, Transform) turns recorded conversations into structured, citable answers for AI search engines. Source: Episode 001.
